minus_idioms.source: No Finnish idiom puts 'miinus' before a positive number.

of.source: Finnish has no word that multiplies a scale word.

fraction_of.source: Finnish puts no word between a fraction and a collective.

denominator_particle.source: Finnish has no particle like Portuguese 'avos'.

class_noun.source: Finnish has no class noun after a collective.

half_unit.source: Finnish puts 'puoli' before the unit ('puoli kiloa'), not after the joiner.

abbreviation.source: No Finnish number word is also an abbreviation with a period.

lone_decimal_mark.source: The comma is the Finnish decimal mark (ICU 78 (CLDR 48) formats 1234567.89 in fi as "1 234 567,89"), so ',5' is 0.5.
